payload.title: User registration: show confirmation email notice
payload.body:
## Context
In `apps/mediapulse/user-registration`, we should set expectations after a user submits registration.

## Request
Show a message indicating:
- The user will receive a confirmation email once registration is complete
- The email may take a few minutes to arrive

## Acceptance criteria
- A visible message is shown in the registration flow after submission (or wherever is appropriate in the existing UX)
- Copy includes both: confirmation email will be sent when complete + may take a few minutes
- Message style matches existing UI patterns in the app

## Suggested copy
“You’ll receive a confirmation email once your registration is complete. It may take a few minutes to arrive.”
